tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyi sgrub slob ma la phan pa'i tshe rta'i zin bris bzhugs so//

༄༅// rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du gsal ba'i hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rta mgrin la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+yā/ shap+ta sa mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog/ lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag bya/ badz+ra muḥtshogs zhing rang la thim/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces yid dang 'dre bar bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥlas dbyug tho hrīḥyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pas rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po sbom zhing brjid pa/ shin tu khros shing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma 'khyog la 'khyug pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang sngon mngon par 'phags pas rta skad drag tu 'tsher ba/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/

phyag g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug tho nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdig mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi'i gdan la ye shes kyi me ris me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar stod du hūm̐/ smad du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥde las 'od 'phros/ bsgom pa 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi bum pas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil bas 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+tas mchod/ hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog sku// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs sreg /bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo rta mgrin phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ byu ru'i 'phreng ba lta bus bskor ba de las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa'i rnam pa 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad la lcags kyus btab/ zhags pas bcings te drangs la bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam la brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o// bdag bskyed do// de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma la swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod pa nas bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas/ bum pa swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nas bstod pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ bzla dus thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi byin rlabs bsdus te thugs kar thim/

mthar 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chur bsam mo// de nas slob ma khrus byas/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bgegs la gtor ma byin/ snying po'i sngags kyis phyir bskrad/ 'og thams cad rdo rje sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa phyi me ri kha dog lnga rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsal// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bla ma khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub sems kyi sdom pa len snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum/ khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gyis/ bla ma khro bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ bdag la rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas slob ma swa bhā nas bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin gyis lhar bskyed/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma'i lha la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi sku'i rnam par che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam steng nas kha ba babs pa lta bu/ 'og nas sa rlangs 'thon pa lta bu/ bar nas bu yug 'tshub pa lta bur byon nas khyod rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis byas la gtor mas dbang bskur snying po brjod/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// =sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa gzungs sngags yig 'bru'i rnam par ngag la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis

byas mgrin par bskur/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// =thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rdo rje dbyug tho la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par= yid la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis byas snying gar bskur/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// mthar gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas khyod rang rnams la thim pas nad gdon bgegs sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad thul thul tshig nas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces slar spyi bor bskur ro// gal te sngags kyi dbang 'dod na/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng byu ru'i 'phreng ba lta bur thon/ khyed rang rnams rta mgrin du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs pa'i mos pa gyis byas la sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa byed du bcug bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me tog spyi bor bzhag slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ dbang zin nas gtor ma'i zan slob ma la sbyin no/ /rang nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+ta sa mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag bya/ badz+ra muḥtshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa shin tu zhi zhing mdzes pa mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs ka'i cha stod du hūm̐/ cha smad du zla ba la hrīḥsngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba de las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dang*/ chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+yā/ shap+ta sa mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// ces sogs bstod/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsring bsod nams skyed nus pa thams cad bsdus te snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsams la bzla/ bdag bskyed do// mdun bskyed tshe bum ril bu chang rnams swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ bstod pa'i bar byas/ mdun bskyed bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya dus/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i tshe nyams pa bkug 'byung bzhi/ sems can gyi tshe dang*/ bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus/ bum pa'i nang du 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsir bsam la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi wan+tī ye swā hā 'am/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bzla/ las bum rta mgrin gyi bum bskyed ltar bsgrubs/ de nas slob ma khrus byas nas bgegs gtor btang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can gyis gsol ba btab/ bla ma tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub sems kyi sdom pa len bsams pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga nas 'od 'phros zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod nas/ khyed rnams kyi tshe gdon bgegs kyis phrogs pa/ nyams pa/ yar ba/ 'chi bdag gis sbas pa thams cad bsdus/ bum par thim/ tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ zhu zhing khol/ chil gyis lud pa khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas tshe nyams pa gsos nas slar 'phel ba'i mos pa gyis byas bum pas dbang bskur/ gzungs ring thung brjod/ de nas tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ zhes pa'i shis brjod byas/ yang dbang rten gyi mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ ri rab gser gyi ri bo sogs 'byung ba sa'i khams la brten nas tshe bsring bar nus pa thams cad bsdus te bum par thim/ =lus thams cad gang bas/ lus sra zhing 'thas pa gang gis kyang gzhom pa dang gzhig par mi nus pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa gyis byas nas dbang bskur/ tshe mi 'gyur ba sogs dang*/ de yi nye bar ston pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// zhes sogs brjod= 'og gzhi chu'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho brgyad sgra mi snyan gyi 'chi med kyi tshe chu la sogs pa 'byung ba chu'i khams la brten nas tshe bsring bar nus pa= lus snum bag gzi brjid dang ldan pa tshe'i dngos grub= dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug/ ces brjod= 'og gzhi me'i dkyil 'khor nyi ma rta gdong gi me sogs 'byung ba me la brten nas tshe bsring bar nus pa= lus drod bkrag mdangs rgyas pa'i tshe'i dngos grub=

rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams stobs dag dang*// brjod= 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo bar byed 'dzin sdud smin par byed pa 'byung ba rlung la brten nas tshe bsring bar nus pa= lus yang zhing g.yo ba stobs dang ldan pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob= bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// brjod= tshangs pa brgya byin sogs tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa rnams dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams shes rab thams cad rgya mtsho chen po las chu bcus pa ltar bsdus te/ tshe dang bsod nams zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel ba'i tshe'i dngos grub= lo brgya thub cing stong brgya mthong ba dang*// brjod= dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas gcig la gcig dgyes bzhin par 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun bsdus te =lus ngag yid mi shigs pa tshe'i dngos grub thob= sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// brjod= de nas dbang rten gyi mgon po'i smin mtshams kyi oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smin mtshams su zhugs te sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa oṃ yig gi rnam par bsdus te khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus 'chi ba med par gyur pa oṃ yig gis rgyas btab/ dbang rten gyi mgon po'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mgrin par zhugs te gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa āḥyig gi rnam par bsdus te khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag 'chi ba med par gyur pa āḥyig gis rgyas btab/ dbang rten gyi mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kar zhugs te thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa hūm̐ yig gi rnam par bsdus te khyed rang rnam pa'i snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

yid 'chi ba med par gyur pa hūm̐ yig gis rgyas btab/ dbang rten gyi mgon po'i gnas gsum las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas gsum nas zhugs/ sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bsdus te khyed rang rnam pa'i gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi 'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob pa'i mos pa gyis byas dbang bskur/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog/ ces brjod= mthar dbang rten gyi mgon po 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang sku gsung thugs ye shes gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa gyis byas dbang bskur/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// ces shis pa brjod= tshe ril dang tshe chang byin maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// tshe dbang brgya rtsa byed na dbang rten gyi mgon po bskyed pa'i bar 'dra la/ de las 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe gdon bgegs kyis phrogs shing nyams pa dang sbas pa/ 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas tshe sring bar nus pa/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus te bum par thim/ tshe'i bdud rtsir zhu zhing 'khol/ chil gyis lud pa khyed rang rnams tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas tshe nyams pa gsos te slar 'phel ba'i mos pa gyis

byas la dbang bskur ba nas shis brjod bya ba'i bar sngar dang 'dra'o// tshe rta zung 'brel du byed na/ rta mgrin gyi bdag mdun bum pa'i bar ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs/ bdag bskyed de nyid de nas mdun bskyed tshe dpag med kyang bsgrub bskul ba'i bzlas pa byas nas/ rta mgrin gyi khyad par gyi gsol gdab byas/ sdom pa phog rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang byas/ de nas bla ma rta mgrin du gsal ba de nyid tshe dpag tu med par gsal thob la tshe dbang zhu snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// lan gsum gyi mthar tshe dbang bskur ba yin no/ /sngags dbang 'dod na slob dpon tshe dpag med par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng 'thon/ khyed rang rnams tshe dpag med par gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa gyis byas la/ sngags gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas/ bcom ldan 'di la dang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis zhes brjod par bya'o// pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
